title: The Zombie Who Lost His Head
premise: A dawn sneeze blows zombie Pip's head loose onto a wet plaza; after a frantic puddle chase past a shocked commuter and safety rail, he slaps it back on backwards and walks straight into a tram pole.
hook: At dawn on the tram plaza, one massive sneeze pops Pip's own head clean off his shoulders!
narration: One sneeze blew Pip's head off! It bounced across the dawn curb. Pip dashed while commuters stared! It ducked past the orange rail! Pip slipped, then scooped his head back up. He stuck it on backwards — straight into a pole!

beats.action: Pip winds up and sneezes his own head clear off his shoulders
Detached head bounces twice across the cobblestone curb and rolls away
Headless Pip sprints past commuter Maya whose eyes pop in disbelief
Pip hurdles over an orange safety rail while Maya ducks behind a shelter post
Pip skids on a puddle and stumbles forward just short of the head
Pip reaches out both hands and scoops up his runaway head
Pip slaps his head back onto his poncho collar completely backwards
Confident Pip marches straight into the tall tram stop pole as Maya gasps
